title: Album Cover with Portrait and Stylized Text
coreRelationships: The man's face is centrally positioned, dominating the composition.
The bright blue eyes provide a strong focal point against the muted tones of the face and the black background.
The white text elements frame the portrait, creating a balanced top and bottom visual weight.
The black background creates a strong contrast with the illuminated face and white text, emphasizing the subject.
reuseFormula: Generate a high-contrast, centrally-focused portrait of a subject with vibrant blue eyes against a pure black background. Overlay custom-modified, monospaced geometric sans-serif white text, with specific character inversions and substitutions, centered above and below the portrait.

The face should be centrally positioned, occupying approximately 60-70% of the image height.
